gated_on: P3-CONTRACT-EXEC v2 = CONTRACT_PASS_FLOAT64 (results/contract_exec_v2/); v1 float32 = CONTRACT_FAIL_BLOCKED is kept
what_this_is: A small pilot of REAL-01R on real GPT-2 small + res-jb L8. It checks that the pipeline runs end to end and gives first estimates with uncertainty. Its readouts are NOT gate decisions: G1-G3 are reported descriptively; the decision gate needs the full REAL-01R run.

overrides_vs_base.precision: float64 (model, SAE, solves), per the contract-exec v2 interpretation rule
overrides_vs_base.pilot_features: 8, a seeded subsample ('pilot-features', calibration config id) of the 64 frozen calibration features
overrides_vs_base.admissible_edits: all edit directions are projected by P = I - 11^T/d; the LN correction solves (M P) delta = t (J_E P); every row records 'admissible'
overrides_vs_base.mean_only_control: delta along 1/sqrt(d) in both modes; diagnostic of internal change without external effect; never counted as a method

fixed_from_base: calibration-only features and doses (q50/q90/q99/2xq99; norm budgets 0.025/0.05/0.1/0.2 x median centred norm)
equal-norm and target-matched modes kept separate; INFEASIBLE rows kept
metrics: target error, D_orig (kept/deact), D_new, D_all, edit norm, mean component, KL and dNLL over 16 downstream positions, solve/forward seconds, peak RSS
document-cluster bootstrap (2000 resamples) of per-document means; features and tokens are never counted as independent samples
not_in_scope: behavioural or semantic success (P3-REAL-02 not run)
any claim about external control from internal metrics
